notes.title: BrokenLore x HORROR GAME AWARDS
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the Brokenlore series is participating in the [i][b]Horror Games Awards[/b][/i]. During the event, we presented two new trailers for two games in development in the series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/3fcc3c1784249fee433e6be9add7c7463f025cb4.gif[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][b]BrokenLore: FOLLOW[/b][/url] explores the complex relationship between mother and daughter, and to ensure an authentic and profound representation, it is being developed in collaboration with a psychologist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/9190f73e89f98cb8633a63b0448fc283b8491cbc.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][b]BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH[/b][/url] is a psychological horror game about a young hikikomori trapped in his apartment in Tokyo. notes.title: NEW DEMOS for the BrokenLore Saga!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that the demos for BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH and BrokenLore: LOW are now available! We invite you to try them out and add them to your wishlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/b456169b3e3fab23d71d7c10ff1520ba41487720.jpg[/img]

BrokenLore features an intricate story that will be revealed piece by piece, following a narrative inspired by the [i]Hyakumonogatari Kaidankai[/i]. Each game will be an essential piece of the puzzle that unveils the entire lore, but don’t worry—each title can also be enjoyed individually without the need to have played the others.

[b]BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH[/b]
Follow the story of a hikikomori who lives in isolation in his small Tokyo apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/833083d12103796bb1ef600510c95d98b3639b2a.gif[/img]

[b]BrokenLore: LOW[/b]
An atmospheric horror set in a beautiful rural Japanese town shrouded in mist, hiding a dark curse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/b5f89f3544cc99abdb1390450df08399b03f0cce.gif[/img]

WISHLIST [b]Ghost Frequency[/b]
We are also excited to announce a new game in collaboration with the [i]PIT (Paranormal Investigation Team)[/i], where you will become ghost hunters. The demo is available now, and we anticipate the full game’s release in December 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/74fd923892a208b19e9557f41356305efbc45a54.gif[/img]

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait for you to experience the eerie world of BrokenLore and Ghost Frequency!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3173740/Ghost_Frequency/

The UNFOLLOW Crew

notes.title: NEW CHAPTER IN THE UNFOLLOW SAGA 🎉
notes.content:
We are absolutely delighted to reveal that our creative journey extends beyond [i]UNFOLLOW[/i]! Introducing [i]FOLLOW[/i], the prequel that delves even deeper into the intricacies of human experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/3d32330ac8a28a7d2d76dfb4cbdacf949c3a3cbc.png[/img]

In [i]FOLLOW[/i], we'll embark on a profound exploration of self-acceptance, shedding light on the struggles of overcoming eating disorders, grappling with body dysmorphia, and battling feelings of worthlessness. Moreover, this installment promises to unravel the complexities of early-stage mother-child relationships, offering poignant insights into the human condition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/8623121ac129dd9a30b8d6cbe0659d31e6ec580d.png[/img]

As we venture into this new chapter, we invite you to join us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/af1fe0fcb49f1bb2abd54cc9713e59fb4466f1e7.gif[/img]

[b]WISHLIST NOW
[/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2846530/FOLLOW/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2846530/FOLLOW/[/url]

notes.title: NEW DEMO OF UNFOLLOW
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we have a brand-new demo for UNFOLLOW!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/295705dc639a25adcd2fce017c88bc16014b6255.jpg[/img]

In this new demo, we explore a different aspect of the story, allowing you to delve deeper into the protagonist's relationship with her beauty-obsessed mother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/6261e05ade0075d35a7e752ff9860b40529c854e.gif[/img]

You will encounter comments posted by users throughout this demo. Although the users, their names, and their profile pictures are real, their comments are purely fictional. These individuals have been supporting us throughout the development of "UNFOLLOW" by simply following us on social media. Due to the nature and content of this title, we have decided to include them in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/745943a45a707b85ccac1bc9c817b30ac45901e4.jpg[/img]

We deeply care about the themes of this game, and we are overwhelmed by the support you have shown. UNFOLLOW continues to grow, and that's all thanks to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/a93ce3fd2a18a76aa0102ff11d0591ecabf5118e.gif[/img]

SOME UPDATES
➤ Multiple endings will be influenced by the various choices made throughout the game.
➤ Emphasis will be placed on Anne's smartphone, which will feature numerous functions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/a8cddff4fbd9abae515f3f5cdb984a66749ac7d8.jpg[/img]

We would like to thank those who believed in the project from the beginning.]

notes.title: UNFOLLOW: HEART MILK SPAGHETTI with Barbascura, Knite, Luca Occhi

Today we will play UNFOLLOW with Barbascura, Knite, Luca Occhi, Marion Blue from the Cast, and the game creator Sebastiano Serafini. We will be playing the Internation and Italian versions of the game.

[u][b]Update [Beta v0.8.20230207][/b][/u]
- General optimization
- Improvement to the setting
- Add in-game options button
- Adjust inventory
- Balanced the FOV of the character
- Slightly increased walking and running speed
- Modified intro 
- General bug fixes

We can't wait to show you more!
